weaknesses.title: IF on stored LET counts flaky after COUNT/HAS — use LAST_N immediately
weaknesses.detail: IF band_n > 0 / IF admit == 1 failed to take branch after COUNTBETWEEN even when SYS STR band_n printed 3. Nested IF and flat IF on LET vars both failed; IF LAST_N > 0 right after COUNTBETWEEN worked.
weaknesses.repro: COUNTBETWEEN; LET band_n=LAST_N; IF band_n > 0 THEN LET admit=1 — admit stays 0 under -s

weaknesses.title: Unknown-action EQS wall + REQUIRE EXIT can fire after successful action
weaknesses.detail: After slo_gate set val=admit, footer EQS ACTION/val wall still left is_known=0 and EXIT 2 unknown action when REQUIRE set. Hard REQUIRE exits must stay inside action bodies; unknown wall should be soft-only.
weaknesses.repro: slo_gate admit with CUBALC_QD_REQUIRE=1 → EXIT unknown action

weaknesses.title: HASWHEREGE_N can disagree with COUNTWHEREGE_N in same run
weaknesses.detail: Gate meta showed COUNTWHEREGE hot_n=1 while HASWHEREGE_N=0 for depth≥80 with a live q2@100 after prior HASBETWEEN.
weaknesses.repro: HASBETWEEN; HASWHEREGE; COUNTWHEREGE same thr — N mismatch

weaknesses.title: HAS* returns first match only — not multi-name bag
weaknesses.detail: HASBETWEEN first q0 only; full set needs WHEREBETWEEN.

weaknesses.title: No SUMF/AVGF on WHEREBETWEEN subset
